title: Special Executive Masters Programme in Enterprise Software And Business Infrastructure
description: The Special Executive Masters Programme (SEMP) in Enterprise Software and Business Infrastructure is a comprehensive course equips professionals to implement and manage enterprise software and business infrastructure.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and Rushford Business School
longDescription: The Special Executive Master Programme (SEMP) in Enterprise Software and Business Infrastructure is designed to equip professionals with the skills and knowledge necessary to excel in leadership and management roles within the technology and business infrastructure sectors. The Programme offers an efficient approach beyond traditional classroom learning. The course emphasises real-world applications through case studies, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning, allowing participants to practice what they learn in a controlled environment before applying it to their roles. The Special Executive Master Programme in Enterprise Software and Business Infrastructure allows you to achieve the qualification in 6 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. The program effectively prepares learners to tackle complex operational challenges by integrating theoretical knowledge with practical applications. This programme aims to deliver a practical and realistic solution to Enterprise Software and Business Infrastructure challenges, supported by appropriate reference to theoretical and conceptual analysis.
courseDetails: The objective of the Special Executive Master Programme in Enterprise Software and Business Infrastructure is to prepare students for leadership roles in technology and business infrastructure by providing them with knowledge and skills in database management system, Project Management, and Management Information System. This qualification reflects current practices in enterprise software and business infrastructure, allowing learners to develop and expand their high-level understanding of technology and business solutions. Course Details: Database Management Systems: In this Module student will learn the fundamentals of designing, implementing, and managing databases for efficient data handling. Enterprise Resource Planning: This module focuses on understanding the integration of business processes using ERP systems to enhance organizational efficiency. Enterprise Software Development: In this module student gain skills in designing and developing large-scale enterprise software applications. Information Systems Development: This module explores methodologies for creating and managing effective information systems. Management Information Systems: In this module learner study how information systems support business operations and strategic decision-making. Project Management: This module makes student acquire knowledge to plan, execute, and manage projects efficiently within scope, time, and budget constraints. Assessment: Graduation Project (GP) Upon finishing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project (GP) that combines and utilizes the knowledge acquired across different modules. This qualification embodies current practices in Enterprise Software and Business Infrastructure and helps learners deepen and broaden their understanding of the field at an advanced level. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises 6 modules with 30 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.

entry: There are no strict entry requirements for this course. Work experience will be added advantage to understanding the content of the course.
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

lessons.title: Summarising, Paraphrasing, Quotation for your Assignment

modules.title: DATABASE MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS
modules.summary: The course emphasizes the understanding of the fundamentals of relational systems including data models, database architectures, and database manipulations. The course also provides an understanding of new developments and trends such as Internet database environment and data warehousing.

modules.title: ENTERPRISE RESOURCE PLANNING
modules.summary: This course will enable students to understand issues and decisions that must be made when embarking upon an ERP selection and implementation journey. It will also lead to an understanding of the challenges associated with managing extant ERP systems. In the process, students will become familiar with the forces and organizational conditions leading to the acquisition of such enterprise-wide systems.

lessons.title: VIDEO - ERP in the Life of Tomorrow's CFO
ERP And Production Systems, Erp Modules
DEMO - Oracle Enterprise Resource Planning - Financial Analytics
Module Introduction And Introduction To Enterprise Systems And Organization
IT Infrastructure And Administration Of Enterprise Systems
CASE STUDY - Enterprise Network Migration To Secure Cloud Environment
IT Infrastructure And Administration Of Enterprise Systems 2

modules.title: INFORMATION SYSTEMS DEVELOPMENT
modules.summary: This course introduces the information system development process to the students. During course the students will learn about the main development frameworks, defining of system requirements, and modeling of data, architecture and components’ interactions an information system.

lessons.title: CASE STUDY - Staying Ahead in a Competitive Environment
CASE STUDY - Virtual Reality Store - IKEA
VIDEO - Information system in Business Environment

modules.title: MANAGEMENT INFORMATION SYSTEMS
modules.summary: This course provides a broad overview of the issues managers face in the selection, use, and management of information technology (IT). Increasingly, IT is being used as a tool to implement business strategies and gain competitive advantage, not merely to support business operations.

lessons.title: VIDEO - Information in Management Decision Making

modules.title: PROJECT MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: To understand the process of identifying appropriate and feasible projects, and to be able to initiate and start a project. To be able to manage, monitor and control a project, including assessing, managing and controlling project risks and issues, project, and team management and change management. To be able to evaluate the success or failure of a project.
